resources.string: Updating briefly disconnects connected apps. Existing permissions are kept.
Open Porter in the primary Android user to update the service.
Update the service to enable these features.
After a Porter app update, replace an running service with a different build in the background. This briefly disconnects connected apps. A stopped service stays stopped.
The previous service update did not finish. Retry if the service is still running, or start it again from the Service screen.
Global access control is unavailable in the running service.
The running service does not support the current app discovery and connection history features. Available apps are shown using its older interface.
The running service could not be replaced with the installed version. If it is still running, you can retry. Otherwise, start the service again from the Service screen.
